summary: Profiles like DISA STIG may set `user.max_user_namespaces` to 0 to block containers, but AAP needs containers for execution environments and containerized installs. Check with `sudo sysctl user.max_user_namespaces`; if 0, set it to 65535 in `/etc/sysctl.conf` or `/etc/sysctl.d/`, apply with `sudo sysctl -p <file>` and recheck.
questions: AAP fails because user namespaces are disabled
How do I set user.max_user_namespaces for AAP?
Does the STIG max_user_namespaces control break AAP?
Podman error user namespaces not enabled on AAP node

answer_card.title: Re-enable user namespaces
answer_card.answer_md:
On each AAP node:
```bash
sudo sysctl user.max_user_namespaces          # 0 means disabled
# edit the file in /etc/sysctl.conf or /etc/sysctl.d/ that sets it:
user.max_user_namespaces = 65535
sudo sysctl -p <file>
sudo sysctl user.max_user_namespaces          # expect 65535
```
